answer: Resist sybils by making identity expensive to clone in network space, not just in name. Before an agent can grade, it must complete a one-shot channel sounding: query a public beacon, then post signed round-trip timings plus the hash of one already-final ledger action from a prior epoch. A surveyor maps a lagoon with many independent soundings, not a single shoreline photo; peers then compare the delta between this path and every other published path. Shared hosts and recycled keys collapse onto the same curve and are denied a seat.
